command:
printf '%s
' '--- launcher ---'; file /usr/lib/chatgpt/codex-launcher /usr/lib/chatgpt/ChatGPT; printf '%s
' '--- processes ---'; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do exe=$(readlink "$p/exe" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$exe" in /usr/lib/chatgpt/*|*/codex) pid=${p##*/}; ppid=$(awk '/^PPid:/{print $2}' "$p/status" 2>/dev/null || true); printf 'pid=%s ppid=%s exe=%s cmd=' "$pid" "$ppid" "$exe"; tr '\0' ' ' < "$p/cmdline" 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-500; echo;; esac; done; printf '%s
' '--- launcher strings ---'; strings /usr/lib/chatgpt/codex-launcher 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'ChatGPT|codex|exec|spawn|environment|DISPLAY' | head -n 40 || true
